newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

DAILY NEWS Troops of Operation "Jaya Sikuru" on Wednesday captured Omanthai, 14 km north of Vavunia, along strategic Vavunia-Jaffna highway. The military launched a massive offensive into the rebel-held Wanni region on Tuesday.
Troops recapture Omanthai on Wednesday. Twenty-three soldiers were wounded in the battle for this town, security sources say.
Troops near Puliyankulam after capturing Omanthai on Wednesday, security sources say.
Operation Jaya Sikuru moves forward slowly amid rebel landmines and booby traps, security sources say.
Tiger separatists attack radar station on northern Kytes island.
